name: copy_pattern
note: Chal badalti rehti hai - sirf pichle 3-6 mahine me parkho, 13 saal par nahi.

pair.copy_rule: y in N(x) or y in N(palat(x)), y not in (x, palat(x)); N(v) = v+-1, v+-10 (0..99)

shapes.seedha: din1 = x, din2 = y, [din3 gap], din4 = teesra
shapes.ulta: din1 = x, [din2 gap], din3 = y, din4 = teesra

set: x, y, palat(x), palat(y)  (4 jodi; palat wale halka play)
pass: din4 par set ka koi number kisi bhi game me aaye
unclear: '10 dane' ka matlab (maine +-10 ka farak maana)
teesra number x se ya y se - maine dono + palat liye
pass kis game me - maine kisi bhi game
